node.title: Re^2: Print Behavior with Carriage Return
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[doc://chomp] will then remove both line ending characters.

Nitpick: I/O layers don't change the behavior of [doc://chomp], it will continue to remove [doc://$/], which is typically one character, " ", even on Windows. The I/O layer converts to when reading, so the strings end in just " " before they are even touched by [doc://chomp].
